# ActorRating

> Community ratings for individual acting performances — craft criteria, not overall film quality.

ActorRating is a catalog where people rate an actor’s work in a specific movie. Public community scores use signed-in ratings only (guest ratings are excluded from the public average). Scores are shown on a 0–10 scale.

Website: https://actorrating.com  
Methodology: https://actorrating.com/methodology  
Sitemap: https://actorrating.com/sitemap.xml  
Contact: contact@actorrating.com

## How scores work

See https://actorrating.com/methodology for the live rules: five craft criteria (UI labels: Emotional Impact, Character Depth, Technical Skill, Screen Presence, Originality), per-rating mean then mean across signed-in raters, Bayesian ranking prior for short lists (m=5), and refresh intervals.

## URL patterns (public corpus)

- Actor: `https://actorrating.com/actors/{actor-slug}`
- Movie: `https://actorrating.com/movies/{movie-slug}`
- Performance (rate page): `https://actorrating.com/rate/{movie-slug}/{actor-slug}`
- Best performances hub (allowlisted films): `https://actorrating.com/movies/{movie-slug}/best-performances`
- Example hub: https://actorrating.com/movies/the-odyssey-2026/best-performances

## Indexability (honest summary)

- Not every `/rate/...` URL is indexable. Indexable rate pages generally require an eligible role tier, a non-featurette title, and enough signed-in community ratings (see site `robots` meta / rate-page gate).
- `/admin`, `/api`, `/auth`, `/dashboard`, `/profile`, `/search`, and similar product surfaces are disallowed or noindex.

- [News](https://actorrating.com/news)

## Citation

Cite ActorRating community scores only when the page shows a real community aggregate. Prefer the canonical `/rate/{movie}/{actor}` URL. Do not treat TMDB film averages as ActorRating craft scores.
